_about: Photographic placements. The build replaces <!--STILL:id--> with assets/img/stills/<id>.jpg when it exists (and <id>-m.jpg on phones, if present), otherwise with a labelled placement carrying the brief. ratio/ratio_m are the desktop and phone frames; focus/focus_m are the object-position on each. temp is the light family (night, dusk, day). Full briefs and Midjourney prompts: docs/image-briefs.md.

home-rain.page: Home · Ways a brief can begin
home-rain.title: 2am, monsoon on the glass
home-rain.subject: A notebook on a sill: one sentence crossed out and rewritten, a glass of tea gone cold.
home-rain.composition: Close and low, the page sharp in the lower third, the rain-streaked window filling the rest.
home-rain.light: One small tungsten lamp on the paper; the city beyond dissolved into blue rain.
home-rain.purpose: The detail that keeps bothering you usually turns up at this hour.
home-rain.alt: A notebook on a rainy windowsill at night, one line crossed out and rewritten under a small lamp

home-dapple.page: Home · Working in another person's voice
home-dapple.title: Half in leaf shadow
home-dapple.subject: A man in his late forties by an open window, looking just past the lens.
home-dapple.composition: Head and shoulders, eyes on the upper third, the room behind falling away into shadow.
home-dapple.light: Late sun broken by leaves outside; half the face lit, half in moving shade.
home-dapple.purpose: We only ever see part of a person at first. Writing in their voice means learning the rest.
home-dapple.alt: A man by an open window in late daylight, leaf shadows across half his face

home-reflection.title: A city in the water
home-reflection.subject: A coastal city at blue hour held upside down in still water.
home-reflection.composition: The skyline a thin band across the middle; the reflection below loosens until its lights become stars.
home-reflection.light: Blue hour after the sun has gone, a few sodium lights, mist lying on the water.
home-reflection.purpose: A conversation about a film becomes one about a city, and then about something larger.
home-reflection.alt: A city at blue hour reflected in still water, the reflected lights turning into a field of stars

work-field.title: A figure under a very large moon
work-field.subject: One person standing in tall grass, seen from behind.
work-field.composition: The figure less than a twentieth of the frame, left of centre; the moon fills a third of the sky.
work-field.light: Last amber light on the grass tips, the sky above already blue.
work-field.purpose: What a piece of work makes possible is always larger than the person who asked for it.
work-field.alt: A small figure in tall grass at dusk beneath a very large moon low on the horizon

disc-screen.title: A screen in a field
disc-screen.subject: A touring cinema at night: a cloth screen on bamboo poles in an open field, a few people on the ground.
disc-screen.composition: Screen right of centre, the beam crossing low mist from a tent at the left edge; viewers small, seen from behind.
disc-screen.light: The blank screen is the only light. It falls across the grass and makes the mist visible.
disc-screen.purpose: An idea crossing the air from one form into another, and arriving in front of people.
disc-screen.alt: A cloth cinema screen glowing in a dark field at night, a projector beam crossing the mist toward it

how-dusk.title: Dusk reaches the worktable
how-dusk.subject: Contact sheets with one frame circled, a loupe, notes with a line rewritten, a pressed leaf, a chair pushed back.
how-dusk.composition: Standing height, a slight angle across the table, focus on the loupe and the circled frame.
how-dusk.light: Low sun through the window lies across the table in one amber band; the rest of the room has gone blue.
how-dusk.purpose: The things that rarely make it into a brief are already on the table.
how-dusk.alt: Low dusk sunlight across a worktable with contact sheets, a loupe, handwritten notes and a pressed leaf

about-cinema.title: Out of the cinema, after rain
about-cinema.subject: A woman stepping out of a single-screen cinema onto wet pavement, still half in the lobby light.
about-cinema.composition: She is small, right of centre, caught mid-step; marquee light streaks across the ground toward the lens.
about-cinema.light: Marquee bulbs and one red neon sign on wet ground; the street beyond in teal dark.
about-cinema.purpose: The page opens on that line about cinema following you out. This is the moment it starts.
about-cinema.alt: A woman stepping out of a cinema onto a wet street at night, marquee light reflected on the pavement

about-stella.title: Stella John, at dusk
about-stella.subject: Stella, photographed, not generated. A camera or notebook in hand, unposed.
about-stella.composition: Three-quarter, eyes on the upper third, room enough around her to breathe.
about-stella.light: Window light at dusk, warm on skin, shadows left open.
about-stella.purpose: A founder's note needs the founder's face, and the face should belong to the same world as the work.
about-stella.alt: Stella John, founder of VALENCE, photographed by a window at dusk

contact-train.title: A train window at dusk
contact-train.subject: A woman in profile on a long-distance train, a closed notebook on her lap, thinking.
contact-train.composition: Her face on the left third; her reflection and the passing fields layered in the glass to the right.
contact-train.light: Last orange light outside, the carriage in cool shadow, her face lit softly by the window.
contact-train.purpose: The thing taking up room in your head is usually layered over whatever you are looking at.
contact-train.alt: A woman in profile beside a train window at dusk, her reflection layered over the passing fields

letter-sill.title: A letter and the first crescent
letter-sill.subject: A folded handwritten letter on a wooden windowsill.
letter-sill.composition: The fold in focus in the lower half; a thin crescent moon low in the glass above.
letter-sill.light: A lamp out of frame warms the paper; the sky outside is deep blue.
letter-sill.purpose: The letter goes out at the new moon. The thin crescent is the first sign it has begun again.
letter-sill.alt: A folded letter on a windowsill at night, a thin crescent moon low in the window

conv-table.title: Between two people
conv-table.subject: Two people across a café table, shoulders down: one hand mid-gesture, the other around a cup, a recorder between them.
conv-table.composition: Wide and close at table height; a glass of water throws a bright ring of light onto the tabletop.
conv-table.light: Late afternoon sun across the table, warm skin, moss and terracotta in the soft background.
conv-table.purpose: People become interesting in the particulars, and the particulars are often in the hands.
conv-table.alt: Two people's hands across a café table in late sun, a recorder between them and a ring of light from a water glass
